consent.title: The customer's answer
consent.waiting: This order waits for the customer's answer. Someone who may update orders records it.
consent.body: The order waits for the customer. Record what they said and how they said it; nothing changes until you do.
consent.SUBSTITUTION: A substitute, or less than they ordered
consent.HIGHER_TOTAL: A weighed total above what they agreed

methods.SIGNED_LINK: Through the link they were sent

consent.noteHint: What they said, in a few words.
consent.missing: Choose what they were asked and their answer.

what.SUBSTITUTION: a substitute, or less than they ordered
what.HIGHER_TOTAL: a weighed total above what they agreed

pickList.title: Pick list
pickList.error: The pick lists could not be loaded.
pickList.none: No pick list. The order is {{status}}.
pickList.locationHint: Where the goods are picked from: the cold room, the egg store.
pickList.startBody: A pick list for {{order}} is made at {{location}}.

history.title: What happened
history.error: The history could not be loaded

fulfilments.title: Picking
fulfilments.emptyBody: A confirmed order's pick list appears here when picking starts.
fulfilments.error: The pick lists could not be loaded

pick.error: The pick list could not be loaded
pick.denied: You cannot see this pick list
pick.overTolerance: The weighed total is over what the customer agreed. The order waits for their answer.
pick.awaiting: The order waits for the customer's answer about a substitute or a smaller quantity.
pick.recordAnswer: Record their answer on the order
pick.qtyHint: Pick exactly {{quantity}} {{unit}}. Fewer needs the customer's agreement first.
pick.short: This is fewer than the line needs. Offer the customer a smaller quantity or a substitute first: picking short waits for their agreement.
pick.over: This is more than the line needs. Pick what the order asks for.
pick.weightMissing: Weigh it and write the weight.
pick.lotHint: Leave it to take the oldest.
pick.noneTyped: Write what was picked for at least one line.

cracked.title: Broken or cracked: {{product}}
cracked.body: Found broken while picking at {{location}}. They are written off from stock at their cost.
cracked.countHint: Count each one. A crate with three cracked eggs is 3.
cracked.consequence: This takes them out of stock. The server values them from the stock's cost.
cracked.waiting: Recorded: the write-off waits for a manager to approve it.
cracked.stillPick: The order still needs the full quantity. If there are no more to pick, offer the customer a smaller quantity or a substitute.

substitute.title: Offer the customer something else: {{product}}
substitute.body: The customer is told, and the order waits for their answer. Nothing changes until it is recorded.
substitute.qtyHint: The same product with a smaller number is a short pick offered to the customer.
substitute.noteHint: What the customer is told, for example: 3 eggs were cracked and none are left.
substitute.consequence: The order waits for the customer's answer.
substitute.sent: Offered. The order waits for the customer's answer.

pack.title: Pack
pack.waiting: This waits for the customer's answer before it goes on.
pack.countHint: How many bags or crates the order goes out in.
pack.countMissing: Write how many packages, at least 1.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.body: Dispatching raises the invoice for what was picked, fixes the cash the driver collects and moves the goods onto the van.
dispatch.driversHidden: You cannot list the staff, so the driver is chosen when the run is made.
dispatch.consequence: The invoice is raised for what was picked. The server fixes the cash to collect.

plan.title: Make a run
